clips.title: The story
paras: In southern Darkshore, Onu sends Alliance scouts to investigate the Master's Glaive. He fears the Twilight's Hammer cult may have reached the fallen ancient horror.

Along Darkshore, Onu sees corruption linger and wildlife driven from its homes. The naga on the coast trouble him, but signs of the Twilight's Hammer are worse. Its followers worship primal lords who ruled the world before they were overthrown in ages past.

South of Onu, the Master's Glaive is a grim excavation around a colossal creature pierced by a great stone weapon. Onu gives you a Phial of Scrying and asks you to enter the pit and learn whether the cultists have gathered there. The behemoth has been dead for eons, yet corruptive power still clings to its bones. The Twilight's Hammer may seek to claim it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is strange that the naga are here, in Darkshore. But stranger still...are the Twilight's Hammer. That cult worships the old, old lords of the earth. Lords defeated long ago.
The Master's Glaive, to the south, is a place where such an old lord fell.
Go there and look for more Twilight's Hammer cultists.
Take this phial of scrying. Use it to create a scrying bowl after searching the Master's Glaive. Then speak to me through the bowl.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Go there, then speak with me again.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Twilight's Hammer is at the Master's Glaive?
The old lord impaled by the glaive is long dead, but that does not mean slivers of his power do not still remain.
The Twilight's Hammer must be seeking this power.
